payload.title: Image toolchain step 1: Operation table and generators
payload.description:
Build step 1 of the image toolchain (design: project/wiki/image-toolchain.md, section 9).

`images/operations.py`, error table, generator script, staleness test, empty `skills/image-work/SKILL.md` with the generated block, `docs/images.md` reference. Handlers return `not_implemented`.

Specs: `features_backend/image-operations.feature`: generated CLI, MCP schema, TS types and skill block match the table; CLI and MCP adapters give identical JSON for each example against a fake backend.

What deploys: Nothing.

Fulfils or changes: Foundation for 40b7a4, 8ea0f1.

Gherkin specs are required, and every PR merges to develop. Spending is only approved for step 6 (OpenAI gpt-image-2.5-flare, Machines on Machines trial; Batch where nobody waits). Style guidance is data, never code.
